question: Which fixed20..40-bit public-target recoveries complete on one CPU thread under a120s per-cell bound?

claims.text: Fixed public targets are recovered and independently replayed within explicit limits; failures and unattempted levels remain visible.
No performance comparison, asymptotic claim, largest globally feasible scale, statistical population estimate or cryptographic-size attack.

arms.description: Second invocation of identical cached CPU binary

positive.not_applicable_reason: Small known-answer recoveries and all-target oracle unit tests validate the path before launch. Ladder targets derive only from public x search, no logarithm constructed.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Every completed execution corrupts its scalar and requires independent verification rejection outside the reported interval.

factors.name: source_and_build
factors.value: One frozen commit with shared wide-field/deferred-provenance reduction on all arms; original CPU oracle vs parameter-keyed cached oracle.
factors.how: Original reduction included verbatim; only oracle variant changes. Capture rustc and hashes.

factors.name: inputs
factors.how: Public point from first decodable2*x, x starts seed*1009 modp; solver receives only public P,Q. No scalar is constructed.

factors.name: host
factors.how: Same EKS job, CPU2,memory4Gi; one software thread per cell; shared VM L0. Capture CPUinfo, affinity, kernel, cgroups. No certified clocks.

factors.name: memory_layout
factors.how: Fresh process per cell; cap1000000 retained tuple rows. Record retained sum-table bytes, not RSS. No reuse between complete recoveries.

factors.name: order
factors.how: Latin four-arm rotation with alternating reversal by round and case.

factors.name: analyst
factors.how: Frozen Rust analyzer reads neutral labels and exact full certificate bytes; labels decoded in report.

comparisons.threshold: Exact certificate verified and kP=Q for each completed fixed public target; incomplete cells remain failures.

randomization.arm_order_reason: Identical u/x paths; per-target reference repetition, increasing-size feasibility stop. No comparative latency inference.

seed_derivation.note: Explicit fixed seeds101,202 at every level.

instance_sampling.rule: Six fixed prime-frontier curves from shared source; two independently specified public target searches per curve.

blinding.how: Identical arms, no treatment difference or timing hypothesis.

power.note: Exact certificate verification, no inference or latency hypothesis.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Unmeasured conservative ceiling; no warmup or performance inference. Complete raw runtime charged.

primary.name: Verified retained relations
primary.definition: Retained relation count in the independently replayed complete certificate; attempts separately include failed queries.

secondary.name: Complete CPU recovery diagnostic
secondary.definition: Curve and public-target construction, all solve stages/trials, independent archive replay and serialization; excludes file I/O, process launch and external replay process.

record: CPUinfo, kernel, process affinity and cgroups
all stage durations and cumulative structural counters

placement.binary_source: Frozen standalone CPU source commit; explicit hashes for scale and verifier.

stopping_rules.rule: At each of6increasing levels run both seeds101,202 and identical armsu/x. Stop before nextlevel if any cell timesout120s,fails or replayfails60s. One job1500s,no retry.

invalidation_rules: An unverified scalar is never a completion. Missing cases must match recorded stop; preserve all errors/timeouts.

decision_rule.text: Report per-cell verified recovery or bound/failure and the largest level with both recoveries. L0 durations descriptive only.
decision_rule.threshold: Certificate replay plus public kP=Q and corruption rejection.
decision_rule.statistic: Exact verified completions and retained full certificates.
decision_rule.interval: exact counts; diagnostic full observed range, no confidence interval

graphs: Complete successful CPU recovery durations, with all failed/unattempted cells separately disclosed.

inadmissible: Calling retained table capacity total peak memory
Calling cached MITM tensor contraction or algebraic progress
Claiming largest feasible scale or rho/external advantage without matched measurements
